name: OmniClip — local AI video repurposing & viral shorts engine
summary: Turn long-form video into viral 9:16 vertical shorts with face tracking and kinetic captions. 100% local video processing — your footage never leaves your machine.
metaDescription: OmniClip is a privacy-first desktop app that repurposes long-form videos into vertical 9:16 shorts: word-level transcription, AI hook detection, smart face tracking, and animated kinetic subtitles.

shots.cap: Ingest any long-form video. OmniClip extracts audio and pinpoints high-virality hooks.

shots.alt: OmniClip — word-based clip trimmer and master player
shots.cap: Trim and re-cut clips simply by clicking words in the transcript. No timeline scrub required.

shots.alt: OmniClip — automatic 9:16 reframing and kinetic caption styles
shots.cap: Auto-follow face tracking and single-pass FFmpeg kinetic captions ready for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts.

jsonld.description: Local-first AI video repurposing platform: word-level transcription, semantic hook curation, MediaPipe face-tracking reframe, and FFmpeg kinetic captions.
